name: spend-bar
description: A bar above the prompt with usage limits or monthly extra-usage spend, session cost, prompt-cache status, context usage, compact and spend-review buttons, spend alerts, and trimming of long shell output

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last response (1h on subscriptions, 5m on most API keys)

collectStats.title: Collect usage stats
collectStats.description: Record token use, tool calls, cache rewrites and context size (metadata only, no prompt text or file contents) for a later spend review

statsDir.title: Stats folder
statsDir.description: Where the event log is written; empty uses %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-toolkit\spend-bar\events on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/claude-toolkit/spend-bar/events on macOS, and $XDG_STATE_HOME or ~/.local/state elsewhere

compactWarnPercent.title: Compact warning (% context)
compactWarnPercent.description: The Compact button turns amber from this share of the context window; 0 turns it off

turnRequestWarning.title: Long turn warning (requests)
turnRequestWarning.description: Show a toast when one main-thread turn reaches this many model requests; 0 turns it off

sessionCostWarning.title: Session cost warning (USD)
sessionCostWarning.description: The session cost turns amber at this many dollars and red at twice it, with a toast at each multiple; 0 turns it off

idleRewriteWarning.title: Idle cache rewrite warning (tokens)
idleRewriteWarning.description: Show a toast when a request after the prompt cache expired rewrites at least this many tokens; 0 turns it off

trimLimit.title: Trim tool output over (characters)
trimLimit.description: Bash, PowerShell and browser_batch results longer than this are cut to their head and tail, the full text saved to a file the note names; 0 turns trimming off
